## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or relevant specification when applicable.

## Validation

List the exact offline checks run and their results. Identify checks not run. If this includes new live evidence, link its predeclared plan and retained packet, including failed or unavailable attempts.

## Evidence and limits

Explain any changed input, fork, fee, state, measurement or UI assumptions. Distinguish regression controls from new execution observations and note remaining unsupported behavior. Confirm whether dependency locks, prepared runtime rules or evidence inventories changed; keep unrelated changes separate.

Do not include credentials or private wallet data. Preserve existing frozen evidence and third-party notices.
